$comment: Implements spec 03 §2.1 (the pack layout and the published JSON Schema at packs/schema/pack.schema.json). This root composes the section schemas for §2.2 (manifest), §3 (structure, learning areas), §4-§6 (assessment), §7 (progression), §8 (reports), §2.1/§8.2 (locales) and §12 (tests).
title: Curriculum pack
description: A complete, versioned curriculum pack loaded by the pack registry. The pack is assembled from the section files in spec 03 §2.1; this document is their validated composition.

reports.description: One entry per file under reports/ (spec 03 §2.1, §8.1). C-8 requires report cards to be template-driven per pack.

locales.description: Translations keyed by language tag, one entry per file under locales/ (spec 03 §2.1, §8.2). Every manifest language must have an entry (runtime check).

tests.description: Contents of tests/*.vectors.json (spec 03 §12). C-10 requires every pack to ship conformance vectors.
